newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-A$ strength hard on some industries - Costello.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-A$ strength hard on some industries - Costello.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Tuesday a strong Australian dollar makes it hard for import-competing sectors of the economy but that it helped to keep inflation down.
The government was not, however, targetting a particular level for the currency, Costello told parliament.

"I have said myself on previous occasions, that is those areas of the Australian economy where there is strong import competition, that a rising dollar makes it harder and you wouldn't have to go far in mixing with manufacturers in Australia to hear that," Costello told parliament.
"On the other hand, a rising currency will contribute to keeping inflation low," he said.
"When asked about the level of the currency I make it clear on behalf of the government, as is the government's decision, that we are not targetting a particular value for the dollar."
